description: A base class for consuming telemetry and event data from devices connected to Hono, and sending commands to these devices. Implements connection setup, message handling, and command dispatching logic using Vert.x and Hono client libraries.

classes.name: HonoExampleApplicationBase
classes.description: A base class for managing connection, message consumption, and command dispatching for devices connected to Hono, using Vert.x and Hono client libraries.

methods.name: HonoExampleApplicationBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing connection properties and the client factory for Hono communication.

methods.name: consumeData
methods.description: Establishes connection, creates message consumers, and waits for user input to terminate.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates and configures message consumers for telemetry and event messages.

methods.name: printMessage
methods.description: Logs message details including tenant, device, content, and payload.

methods.name: handleCommandReadinessNotification
methods.description: Handles notifications indicating device readiness for commands, delegating based on TTD value.

methods.name: handlePermanentlyConnectedCommandReadinessNotification
methods.description: Manages notifications for devices with indefinite or event-based connection, scheduling commands accordingly.

methods.name: createCommandClientAndSendCommand
methods.description: Creates a command client for a device and sends a command based on notification.

methods.name: calculateCommandTimeout
methods.description: Determines timeout for command based on TTD notification.

methods.name: setPeriodicCommandSenderTimerCanceler
methods.description: Associates a timer ID with a canceler function for periodic command sending.

methods.name: cancelPeriodicCommandSender
methods.description: Cancels ongoing periodic command sender for a device.

methods.name: isPeriodicCommandSenderActiveForDevice
methods.description: Checks if a periodic command sender is active for a device.

methods.name: sendCommandToAdapter
methods.description: Sends a command to a device via command client, handling success and failure.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommandToAdapter
methods.description: Sends a one-way command to a device, handling success and failure.

methods.name: buildCommandPayload
methods.description: Builds a JSON payload for a brightness command.

methods.name: buildOneWayCommandPayload
methods.description: Builds a JSON payload for a restart notification.
